subject: Planned subprocessor addition: EdgeStream observability (30-day notice)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Brad Turner <b.turner@zettadata.com>, Megan Lopez <m.lopez@zettadata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned subprocessor addition: EdgeStream observability (30-day notice)

Hi Brad / Megan,

Quick heads up: we plan to add EdgeStream Inc. as an observability subprocessor for a subset of runtime logs and aggregated telemetry used for metrics and alerting. This is a planned change rather than a vendor replacement — EdgeStream will receive only aggregated service logs (no raw customer prompt text) and will process data for ingestion, indexing, and alerting.

Key details (high level):
- Subprocessor: EdgeStream Inc. (https://edgestream.io)
- Purpose: log ingestion, indexed observability, alert evaluation
- Data types: service logs, metrics, aggregated error traces (we are not routing customer prompt text or full raw inputs)
- Locations: primary processing in US (us-west-2); optional EU-ingest nodes for latency (EU processing only for meta/metrics)
- Retention: 30 days by default; shorter retention available by configuration
- Access: EdgeStream will have role-based access to indexed logs; no copy of raw prompt text will be retained in plain form

Attachments: edge-stream-subprocessor-notice.pdf (summary & contract excerpt) and a redacted dataflow diagram.

Per Section 3.4 of our DPA, this serves as the 30-day notice of subprocessor addition. If ZettaData has a material objection to the use of EdgeStream on security or lawful processing grounds, please raise it in writing within 30 days so we can address or provide mitigation.

Action items we suggest on our side:
1) Security will send a short evidence packet (SOC 2 link, encryption notes).
2) We can arrange a call between your security team and Soojin to walk through controls.
3) If you require a contractual amendment (export controls / residency), flag it and we’ll coordinate legal.

Let me know if you’d prefer we pause onboarding while you review.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

[attachment: edge-stream-subprocessor-notice.pdf (summary)]

From: Brad Turner <b.turner@zettadata.com>

Cc: Megan Lopez <m.lopez@zettadata.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Planned subprocessor addition: EdgeStream observability (30-day notice)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the heads up. A few immediate questions from our side so we can triage internally:

1) Will any EU customer data (including metadata that could identify tenants) be processed outside the EU? We need clarity on cross-border transfers and which nodes handle EU traffic.
2) Can you confirm that EdgeStream will not receive raw prompt text or PII? Your note suggests aggregated logs only but want that explicit.
3) We require SOC 2 Type II evidence for any subprocessor with access to logs. Can you share a report or an attest link and the date of most recent audit?
4) Are there contractual clauses ensuring minimize/limit access, logging of EdgeStream access, and a right to audit?
5) If EdgeStream uses subcontractors, please provide their roster.

If you can provide the SOC link and a redacted sample of the dataflow diagram (annotated to show which fields are dropped/hashed), we’ll start an internal review. If this looks like a material change, we may request a temporary pause on onboarding while we evaluate.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Brad Turner
Security Lead, ZettaData
b.turner@zettadata.com

Vanessa / Kimberly —

Thanks for flagging. Initial security notes and recommended evidence to send to Zetta:

Required evidence (recommended packet):
- EdgeStream SOC 2 Type II report (or link to auditor portal) + date of coverage
- Redacted subprocessor contract excerpt that shows data access restrictions and logging clauses
- Dataflow diagram (redacted) that highlights exactly which fields are transmitted to EdgeStream; annotate where pseudonymization/hashing occurs
- Encryption details: key management, at-rest and in-transit (are they using customer-managed keys or provider-managed keys?)
- Access controls: RBAC roles, SSO integration, and retention/deletion processes
- Any subprocessors of EdgeStream (complete roster) and their countries of processing

Operational mitigations we recommend while review is open:
- Keep EdgeStream onboarding paused for EU-tenant traffic until we confirm EU processing location and transfer safeguards.
- Configure shorter retention for ZettaData tenants (30 days -> 7 days) where requested.
- Provide redacted sample logs (remove any tenant IDs / hashed fields) rather than full records.

If Zetta requests right-to-audit language, have Kimberly draft an addendum template (I can provide the security scope). Also confirm whether the account requires HIPAA BAA coverage — if so, EdgeStream may need additional contractual terms.

I can join a call with Zetta security tomorrow afternoon PDT to walk through controls.

Soojin Lee
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Brad / Megan —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Short answers up front:
- EU processing: EdgeStream will process only aggregated metrics in EU nodes for latency; tenant-identifying metadata will remain in our EU region and we will not transfer raw prompt text outside the EU for EU-tenants. We will confirm the specific EU node locations and include them in the detailed packet.
- PII/raw prompts: EdgeStream will not receive raw prompt text; we will send aggregated traces with tenant IDs replaced by pseudonymous identifiers.
- SOC 2: EdgeStream’s most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering 2027-10 through 2028-09) is available to share under NDA. Link: https://attestations.edgestream.io/soc2/edgestream-2028 (access requires short form).
- Contractual protections: We’ve extracted the relevant subprocessor clauses and attached a redacted excerpt in the notice PDF. Kimberly is available to discuss any addendum language; we typically include logging of subprocessor access and a limited right-to-audit clause for customers with elevated needs.
- Sub-subprocessors: EdgeStream provided a roster; none of the roster members are expected to access tenant-level text. We’ll share the roster in the evidence packet.

Next steps we’ll take now:
1) Security (Soojin) will prepare the evidence packet and can join a call to walk Zetta through controls — would tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PDT work?
2) We’ll include a redacted dataflow diagram (attached) that highlights fields removed or hashed before transmission.
3) If you still have material objections after the packet, please provide written notice within 30 days so we can engage legal.

We’re happy to shorten retention for your tenants and to enable IP allowlisting for EdgeStream access as an additional safeguard.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
